snippet.title: Untold Tales of Citadale: The Shadow Maker | Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Buy on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2559760/Untold_Tales_of_Citadale_The_Shadow_Maker/

Untold Tales of Citadale: The Shadow Maker is a top‑down 2D RPG adventure set in a pixel world filled with undead, demons, and dark mysteries. You explore sprawling castle areas, unlock new paths, and engage in turn‑based combat with eerie sound and visuals that capture classic RPG energy.

Progress through open environments that blend exploration and progression, uncover hidden threats, level up your character, and face the forces behind The Shadow Maker’s rising darkness.

If you enjoy atmospheric RPGs with deliberate pacing, strategic battles, and retro aesthetic charm, this game delivers a haunting adventure with depth and personality.

#UntoldTalesOfCitadale #IndieRPG #PixelAdventure #TurnBasedCombat #SteamTrailer
